messages:
Devon Park: hey team — quick heads up, PR #10421 (kv-cache-ttl) CI failed on integ-suite shard 3: failing test `test_cache_eviction` and a snapshot diff for `kvcache/snapshot_v2.json`. link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98765 :frown:
ci-bot: [pipeline failed] job=integ-suite shard=3 check=flake-detected logs: https://ci.redwood.example/logs/98765
Maria Chen: on it, re-running shard 3 now. small note: last week we saw this flake on mac-infra nodes.
Maria Chen: ./scripts/ci rerun --job integ-suite --shard 3 --pr 10421
Samir Patel: thanks. this test is flaky when eviction timing aligns with long GC pauses — I bumped the timeout in a local branch and it passed.
Olga K: the snapshot diff looks like a tiny timing-related KV order change, not a functional regression. see snippet:
```
-  "entries": ["a","b","c"]
+  "entries": ["b","a","c"]
```
Devon Park: if rerun is green we can probably merge after approvals. who’s ok to review the small timeout tweak? @Samir @Olga
Samir Patel: I can review later this afternoon. quick question — do we prefer to add a retry wrapper for this test or increase timeout? both have tradeoffs.
Maria Chen: rerun finished: shard 3 passed, overall integ-suite still failing on snapshot-update job. ci-bot put a link to the failing step.
ci-bot: [pipeline update] job=snapshot-update status=failed logs: https://ci.redwood.example/logs/98766
Olga K: snapshot job failing because test output order changed. we should either accept updated snapshot or stabilize ordering in the code. small PR probably better to stabilize ordering — less churn.
Devon Park: ok. plan: Samir will open a tiny patch to stabilize ordering (deterministic sort) and Maria will re-run the snapshot job. After Samir's patch and 1 approval from Olga we merge.
Samir Patel: opening patch now, will add note in PR description and link back to this thread. cc @Olga K for quick review.
Samir Patel: PR comment: "stabilize: sort kv entries before snapshotting — fixes flaky ordering in test_cache_eviction" — running local integ and unit.
Maria Chen: re-running snapshot job after Samir's change.
ci-bot: [rerun queued] job=snapshot-update triggered by Maria Chen
Devon Park: also FYI — if snapshot job fails again we can fall back to a targeted rerun of the failing test to avoid full snapshot overhead: ./scripts/ci run-test --pr 10421 --test test_cache_eviction
Olga K: nice. if the sort is safe, prefer that over updating snapshots. I’ll review Samir's PR in ~30.
Samir Patel: review pushed. ping me if anything else.
Maria Chen: snapshot-update passed. all green now. ci-bot: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98770
ci-bot: [pipeline passed] PR=10421
Devon Park: awesome — thanks everyone. merging after Olga's approval.
Olga K: approved :thumbsup: go ahead and merge. small follow-up: I’ll add a note in the flaky-tests doc about this pattern.
Devon Park: merged. thanks folks :tada:
_meta: generated: engineering slack thread about PR CI flake and snapshot diff
